name: Classic Pesto Pasta
description: A simple and fast weeknight dinner using fresh basil pesto and parmesan cheese.
recipeIngredient: Salt and black pepper to taste

recipeInstructions.text: Bring a large pot of generously salted water to a boil. Add the penne pasta and cook according to package directions until al dente.
Reserve 1/2 cup of pasta water before draining the pasta.
Toss the warm pasta with olive oil, basil pesto, and parmesan cheese, adding splashes of the reserved pasta water as needed to coat evenly.

notes: Top with fresh cherry tomatoes or toasted pine nuts for extra crunch.
